comment: Analyst article favourable to Oracle that doesn't say who ran the test. Transaction speed was equal, so the analytics half decides. One of its throughput sentences appears to swap the two figures.
evidence: Analyst article on Oracle's MySQL HeatWave launch, vendor-favourable; it does not name who ran the test. CH-benCHmark 100G: OLTP equal (0.02 s latency, 30K transactions/min for both), so the OLAP side decides: 4 concurrent OLAP sessions, HeatWave 35 s vs Aurora db.r5.8xlarge 632 s latency (18x). The OLAP throughput sentence claims 110x for HeatWave but prints .06 for HeatWave and 6.6 for Aurora, apparently swapped.
